answer: Locks are published in sparrow, expire in umber, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 22 aliases hence needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4117 identities would post 4927 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
